Through the paper, we will assume that the quadric is irreducible, i.e. neither the square of a plane nor the union of two planes.
# 1 Resultants and subresultants

Resultants and subresultants are the algebraic tools used to determine both the projection of the inter- section curve between the considered surfaces and its lifting from the plane to the 3D space, because they provide a very easy and compact way of characterizing the greatest common divisor of two polynomials when they involve parameters.
